title: MoM – Bolt Risk Review – Supply Chain – 2026-02-24
content:
Meeting: Bolt Risk Review – Supply Chain
Date: 24 February 2026
Chair: Rachel Kim
Attendees: Rachel Kim (PM/OCM), James Turner (Supply Chain), Sarah Chen (Procurement)

CONTEXT
Meeting called to address single-source supplier risk for Bolt primary packaging component flagged at G5 gate review.

DISCUSSION
- Current supplier (SupplierA) has confirmed capacity for launch volume but cannot guarantee continuity beyond Q3 2026 due to their own capacity constraints
- No qualified backup supplier currently exists in the approved supplier list
- Lead time to qualify a new supplier estimated at 8–10 weeks
- If no contingency supplier is in place before G6, launch supply continuity cannot be assured

DECISIONS
- Sarah Chen to identify and initiate qualification of at least one alternative supplier by 05 March
- James Turner to update supply chain risk register in ePPM once alternative supplier shortlist is confirmed
- Rachel to escalate to governance board if no alternative supplier is identified by 05 March

ACTIONS
- Sarah Chen (Procurement): Identify alternative secondary supplier for Bolt packaging component and submit shortlist by 05 March 2026
- James Turner (Supply Chain): Update supply chain risk register in ePPM with latest Bolt supplier status — dependent on Sarah's shortlist

RISK UPDATE
- Risk severity: HIGH — potential to delay launch or limit supply post-launch if not resolved before G6
